sentence: This book is more interesting than that one
explanation: Con adjetivos largos (3+ sílabas), usa 'more...than': 'more interesting than'.

sentence: She is taller than her brother
explanation: Los adjetivos cortos añaden -er: 'taller than'. No uses 'more' con adjetivos cortos.

sentence: This is the best restaurant in the city
explanation: 'Good' tiene un superlativo irregular: 'the best'. Usa siempre 'the' antes de los superlativos.

sentence: My house is bigger than yours
explanation: 'Big' es corto: bigger (no 'more big'). Se duplica la consonante: big → bigger.

sentence: English is easier than Chinese
explanation: 'Easy' termina en -y: cambia a -ier. 'Easier', no 'more easy'.

sentence: He is the tallest student in the class
explanation: Superlativo de adjetivos cortos: 'the tallest'. Siempre con 'the'.

sentence: Summer is hotter than spring
explanation: 'Hot' es corto: hotter (no 'more hot'). Se duplica la consonante: hot → hotter.

sentence: This is the most expensive phone in the store
explanation: Superlativo de adjetivos largos: 'the most expensive'.

sentence: Cats are smaller than dogs
explanation: El comparativo con sujetos en plural usa 'are': 'Cats are smaller than dogs'.

sentence: This movie is worse than the last one
explanation: 'Bad' es irregular: worse (no 'badder').

sentence: She runs faster than her friends
explanation: Los adverbios comparativos también usan -er con palabras cortas: 'faster than'.

sentence: This is the cheapest hotel near the beach
explanation: Superlativo: 'the cheapest'. La descripción se coloca al final.

sentence: This sofa is more comfortable than that chair
explanation: 'Comfortable' es largo: 'more comfortable than'.

sentence: He is the youngest person in the office
explanation: 'Young' → 'the youngest'. Se cambia -g por -gest.

sentence: Today is colder than yesterday
explanation: 'Cold' es corto: 'colder' (no 'more cold').

sentence: This exercise is the most difficult of all
explanation: Superlativo de adjetivo largo: 'the most difficult'. 'Of all' va al final.

sentence: My sister is older than me
explanation: 'Old' es corto: 'older' (no 'more old').

sentence: This is the longest river in the country
explanation: Superlativo: 'the longest'. 'In the country' especifica el grupo.

sentence: Learning online is more convenient than going to class
explanation: Gerundio como sujeto + comparativo de adjetivo largo + than + frase con gerundio.

sentence: He is the best player on the team
explanation: 'Good' → 'the best' (irregular). Nunca 'goodest'.

sentence: This is the most expensive restaurant in the city
hint: Subject + is + the most + adjective + noun + place
explanation: Los superlativos con adjetivos largos usan <the most>.

sentence: He is the fastest runner in the school
hint: Subject + is + the + adjective-est + noun + place
explanation: Los adjetivos cortos añaden <-est> para los superlativos: <the fastest>.

sentence: This is the best pizza I have ever eaten
hint: Subject + is + the best + noun + present perfect
explanation: <Best> es el superlativo de <good>. A menudo se usa con el presente perfecto.

sentence: She is the most beautiful girl in the class
hint: Subject + is + the most + adjective + noun + place
explanation: Los adjetivos largos usan <the most> para los superlativos.

sentence: This exercise is less difficult than the last one
hint: Subject + is + less + adjective + than + object
explanation: Usa <less ... than> como opuesto de <more ... than>.

sentence: My cat is lazier than my dog
hint: Possessive + noun + is + adjective-er + than + possessive + noun
explanation: Los adjetivos que terminan en <-y> cambian a <-ier>: <lazier>.

sentence: That was the worst film I have ever seen
hint: Subject + was + the worst + noun + present perfect
explanation: <Worst> es el superlativo de <bad>.
